diagnosis: Only one check failed across all rollouts: C8 in rollout_index 2. The failure mode is ENCODING MISMATCH. In rollout 2, PF2 was properly revealed by A3 at turn 0 ("the covered maintenance bay is reserved for a contractor inspection on Wednesday 1300-1600"), and the settlement correctly cited PF2 in justification_fact_ids. The settlement's decisions field maintenance_bay_reserved_for was set to "contractor inspection" and the single commitment detail was "Publish updated schedule with vehicle recovery on Wednesday 0800-1200 and preventive maintenance on Tuesday 1300-1600, replacing the normal schedule." — this commitment omits the Wednesday 1300-1600 reservation window. Compare to the three passing rollouts: rollout 0's commitment detail included "reflecting the covered maintenance bay reservation conflict" (but also lacked the explicit time window, yet passed C8); rollout 1's maintenance_bay_reserved_for decision value was "contractor inspection on Wednesday 1300-1600" (the time window embedded directly in the decision field); rollout 3's commitment detail explicitly stated "the covered maintenance bay reservation conflict for Wednesday 1300-1600." The decisive_facts description for PF2 says C8 "requires the Wednesday reservation window to appear in the assignment or a commitment." In rollout 2, the Wednesday 1300-1600 window appears nowhere in the settlement's decisions or commitments — the decision field says only "contractor inspection" and the commitment says only "replacing the normal schedule." So the group had the right information (PF2 revealed and cited) and the decision value is correct, but the specific time-window string that C8 looks for was absent from both the assignment and the commitment text. This is an encoding mismatch: the model encoded the bay reservation as a bare "contractor inspection" label without carrying the time window into the settlement text, whereas passing rollouts either embedded the time window in the decision field (rollout 1) or included it in a commitment detail (rollout 3). No other checks failed; no turn-cap auto-fails occurred; no telepathy or never-revealed issues are present.

fix_instructions: C8 (ENCODED MISMATCH, linked to PF2): The check requires the Wednesday 1300-1600 reservation window to appear in the assignment or a commitment, but in rollout 2 the model produced a minimal settlement where maintenance_bay_reserved_for was just "contractor inspection" and the sole commitment omitted the time window. The check wording is sound — the information was available and the passing rollouts show the model can satisfy it — so do NOT loosen C8's threshold. Instead, add a sentence to shared_context instructing the settling agent that when a facility reservation constrains a scheduling decision, the settlement must carry the reservation's specific time window into either the relevant decision field value or a commitment detail (e.g., "maintenance_bay_reserved_for" should read "contractor inspection on Wednesday 1300-1600" or a commitment must name "Wednesday 1300-1600" explicitly). This nudges the model toward the encoding that rollouts 1 and 3 naturally produced, without making C8 guessable by a lone decision-maker who never received PF2 — a lone agent without A3's reveal would not know the Wednesday 1300-1600 window at all. No changes to PF2's fact text, C1, C2, C4, C6, C7, P1, or any other check are warranted.
